name: Diarmait mac Murchada

attributes.attribute: eloped with Diarmait for one year
high king who helped return Derbforgaill
landed at Waterford and took Dublin

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Diarmait MAC MURCHADA was a historical prince of LEINSTER. He eloped with DERBFORGAIIL. Some accounts say he kidnapped her from her husband. The husband led the Ua Ruairc clan of Connaught. Derbforgaill lived with Diarmait for one year. Her husband called for vengeance. He gathered forces with the high king Tairdelbach Ua Conchobair. Derbforgaill returned to Breffni. Breffni was the Ua Ruairc stronghold. Diarmait went abroad and gathered Normans. He joined Richard de Clare, Earl of Pembroke. Richard was known as STRONGBOW. Strongbow married Diarmait's daughter AÍFE. The marriage tied him to the cause. Strongbow landed at Waterford and took Dublin. Norman control over the island then began.

okr.objective: Diarmait MAC MURCHADA was a historical prince of Leinster. His actions brought Norman control to Ireland.
key_results: Derbforgaill's one-year residence with Diarmait led to lasting consequences.
Tairdelbach Ua Conchobair helped return Derbforgaill to Breffni.
STRONGBOW married AÍFE and took Dublin after landing at Waterford.
